title: HOSA Annual General Meeting 2026
description: The Annual General Meeting of the Highway Old Students' Association. Election of new executive committee, presentation of the treasurer's report, and discussion of the classroom renovation project.

title: Homecoming & Reunion Weekend
description: A two-day homecoming for all former students. Includes a football match against current students, a tour of the renovated classroom block, and an evening gala dinner.

title: Career Day for S.4 and S.6 Students
description: Old students from various professions speak to current O-Level and A-Level candidates about career paths, university choices, and life after secondary school.

title: Classroom Renovation Fundraising Dinner
description: A fundraising dinner to raise funds for the renovation of the old classroom blocks. Target: UGX 120 million. Guest of honour: Honourable Member of Parliament, Kasanda District.

title: HOSA UK Chapter Meetup
description: Gathering of HOSA members based in the United Kingdom. Discusses contributions to the scholarship fund and diaspora mentorship program.

title: Inter-House Sports Day (HOSA Sponsored)
description: HOSA sponsors the annual inter-house sports day. Alumni are invited to attend, umpire, and present awards to winning houses.
